BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has announced the repurchase of 1,000,000 ordinary shares between July 6th and July 10th, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 217.30 GBp. These repurchased shares are intended for cancellation, and following these transactions, the company holds no shares in treasury, with 663,510,011 ordinary shares currently in issue.
